header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Me. Loving those who spend on one another for My sake has become due upon Me. They will be seated on pulpits made of light; seeing this rank which belongs to them alone, the Prophets and the truthful ones will envy them.” Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) narrates, through the Prophet ﷺ, that Allah Ta'ala said this.

blocks.text:
In another narration of Hazrat Ubadah ibn Samit (RA) it has come: “Loving those who keep in touch with one another for My sake has become due upon Me.”
(Musnad Ahmad)

In yet another narration of Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) it has come: “My love has become due for those who sit together with one another for My sake.”
(Muwatta Imam Malik)

In another narration of Hazrat Amr ibn Abasah (RA) it has come: “Loving those who befriend one another for My sake has become due upon Me.”
(Tabarani, Majma' az-Zawa'id)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: قَالَ اللهُ : اَلْمُتَحَابُّوْنَ فِيْ جَلَالِيْ لَهُمْ مَنَابِرُ مِنْ نُوْرٍ يَغْبِطُهُمُ النَّبِيُّوْنَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في الحب في الله رقم:٢٣٩٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this Hadith Qudsi of Allah Ta'ala: “For those who keep love and affection among themselves for the sake of My greatness and majesty, there are pulpits made of light. The Prophets and the Shuhada (martyrs) will envy them.” Hazrat
